# Pak Hotspot

> Pakistan's free daily news digest: top Tech/AI and Pakistan headlines every morning, with short summaries, source links, candid hot takes, a daily poll, and one-tap sharing.

## What it is
- Single-page digest updated every morning (Pakistan time, PKT).
- Two sections: Tech/AI ("Tech Chaos") and Pakistan ("Pakistan Beat").
- Every story follows a quotable 3-block format: "Kya Hua" (what happened), "Kyun Matter Karta Hai" (why it matters, with a Pakistan angle), "Agay Kya" (what's next) — plus a clearly-separated opinion box ("Cipher's Hot Take").
- Interactive: daily poll with live results, emoji reactions, reading progress bar.
- No account, no paywall, no trackers. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, mobile-first.

## Data
- Stories live in data/news.json: { updated_at, tech: [...], pakistan: [...] }; each story is { title, summary, url, source }.
- Editorial layer (hot takes, poll, mood line) lives in data/takes.json, keyed by story URL. The page degrades gracefully if it is absent.

## Update frequency
- New edition every morning PKT. Freshness is shown on-page ("Updated X ago") and stamped in data/news.json as updated_at (ISO 8601).

## FAQ
- What is Pak Hotspot? A free daily news digest for Pakistan: top Tech/AI and Pakistan headlines each morning with summaries, source links, and hot takes.
- How often is it updated? Every morning, Pakistan time.
- Is it free? Yes — no account, no paywall, no trackers.
